errors.evidence: The y-axis values are absolute numbers representing the count of cars, not measured in thousands. The label is "Брой автомобили" (Number of cars).

errors.text_span: Всяка стълба представлява броя на продадените електрически автомобили за конкретен година.
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, not a simple one. Each year has two bars: a blue one for the absolute number of cars and an orange one for the percentage. The description incorrectly states that each bar represents the number of cars.
The value for the number of cars sold in 2022 is 1,126,682, not 1,226,682.

errors.text_span: Стълбата за 2023 е оцветена в оранжев цвят и показва 3 193 455 продадени електрически автомобила.
errors.evidence: The bar representing the number of cars sold in 2023 (3,193,455) is blue. The orange bars represent percentages, as indicated by the legend.

errors.text_span: Над стълбите са посочени процентите на електрическите автомобили от общия брой продадени автомобили за всяка година
errors.evidence: The percentages are not text labels written above the bars. They are represented by a separate series of orange bars, with the percentage value written inside them.
The percentage for 2023 is 22.3%. The value 21.6% corresponds to the year 2022.
The description fails to mention the legend at the bottom of the chart, which is crucial for understanding the two different data series (blue for number of cars, orange for percentage).
